site.sitedescription: Site lies occupying a small cirque basin on the eastern slope of Sheep Mountain in the Rattlesnake Mountains. The site is a fen that receives some moisture from runoff. The surface is a nearly continuous mat of Sphagnum and other bryophytes. Site lies at the upper limit of Pinus ponderosa, Larix occidentalis, and Pseudotsuga menziesii on south-facing slopes, together with Pinus albicaulis. Dominant trees are Abies bifolia, Picea engelmannii, and Pinus contorta.
